discovery_note: The four captured John 1:1 named searches are bounded candidate probes. P66, P75, and 01 have verse coverage reviews. The 02 identity is reviewed, but its verse coverage and writing layers remain unreviewed. Discovery is incomplete.

identity_only_candidates.classification_citation: British Library, Royal MS 1 D VIII, Codex Alexandrinus (Gregory-Aland 02), https://searcharchives.bl.uk/catalog/040-002353500; Greek parchment codex, New Testament volume; consulted 2026-10-01.
identity_only_candidates.identity_citation: British Library, Royal MS 1 D VIII, Codex Alexandrinus (Gregory-Aland 02), https://searcharchives.bl.uk/catalog/040-002353500; the catalogue identifies this physical volume as GA 02; consulted 2026-10-01.
identity_only_candidates.review_limit: The British Library catalogue lists John on folios 42r-55v and a later missing section, but the digital images are unavailable there. No John 1:1-5 physical coverage, page mapping, writing layer, or date assessment is reviewed in this replay.

witnesses.classification_citation: CSNTM, Manuscript P66, https://manuscripts.csntm.org/Manuscript/Group/GA_P66_Bodmer, manuscript details: Greek papyrus, shelf P. Bodmer II; consulted 2026-10-01.
witnesses.identity_citation: CSNTM, Manuscript P66, https://manuscripts.csntm.org/Manuscript/Group/GA_P66_Bodmer; IGNTP, A Transcription of John in P66, TEI title with document key 10066, https://epapers.bham.ac.uk/id/eprint/1759/10/04_P66.xml; consulted 2026-10-01.
witnesses.coverage_citation: International Greek New Testament Project, A Transcription of John in P66, version 2.1 (2013), TEI page P1, column 1, lines 2–8, verse elements B04K1V1–B04K1V5, https://epapers.bham.ac.uk/id/eprint/1759/10/04_P66.xml; NTVMR manuscript/get metadata for docID 10066, https://ntvmr.uni-muenster.de/community/vmr/api/metadata/manuscript/get/?docID=10066&detail=10&format=json, captured 2026-10-01 in tests/fixtures/p66_metadata_probe.json, labels pageID 10 as folio 1 with John 1:1-14; consulted 2026-10-01.
witnesses.coverage_reason: The IGNTP transcription records surviving Greek in each of John 1:1–5 on page P1, with no separate correction reading inside those verse elements. Some letters are supplied as lost or illegible, so the positive status is partial. Captured NTVMR metadata labels indexed page ID 10 as folio 1; the index also lists these verses on unlabeled page ID 3. The NTVMR index alone is not physical proof.
witnesses.unit_label: Original writing on the opening page of P66
witnesses.unit_citation: IGNTP, A Transcription of John in P66, version 2.1 (2013), page P1, column 1, lines 2–8, https://epapers.bham.ac.uk/id/eprint/1759/10/04_P66.xml; the cited verse elements have base transcription outside correction readings.
witnesses.unit_reason: The recorded positive text is the opening page's original copying; no separate correction reading is used for these five verse reviews.

assessments.citation: CSNTM, Manuscript P66, date field '2nd-3rd Century', https://manuscripts.csntm.org/Manuscript/Group/GA_P66_Bodmer; consulted 2026-10-01. Bounds 101–300 CE cover the two complete centuries; this catalogue range is conditional, not a documented consensus.

assessments.original_notation: Late second or early third century
assessments.citation: CSNTM, Manuscript P66, description, https://manuscripts.csntm.org/Manuscript/Group/GA_P66_Bodmer; consulted 2026-10-01. 'Late' and 'early' have no stated numeric bounds, so no interval is inferred.

witnesses.unit_reason: The reviewed verse material belongs to the main writing on the cited prologue leaf; this review does not date or count any separate correction.
